en-CA.name: Speech Coach
en-CA.summary: Learns how you usually speak from your conversations in Bee, and suggests what to change.
en-CA.description: A personal speaking coach. It learns how you usually speak from your real conversations in Bee, and suggests what to change. Ask how you are doing to hear about your current conversation or your last recap. Practise your own lines in short drills, graded from Bee's transcript of your words. Turn opt-in live coaching on or off, or ask whether practice carried over. Development skill.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask speech coach how am I doing
Alexa, ask speech coach to turn on live coaching
